headlines.title: 外交部：今年上半年 中非贸易亮点纷呈
headlines.summary: 外交部发言人林剑主持例行记者会。有记者问，今年上半年中非贸易取得亮眼成绩，对非洲建交国全面实施零关税举措成效显著。请问发言人对此有何评论？ 林剑表示，今年上半年，中非贸易亮点纷呈。 一是总量加速跃升。中非的进出口商品总额达到1.41万亿元人民币，为历史同期最高，今年的贸易总额有望再上新台阶。二是结构持续优化。三是非洲对华出口潜力不断释放。（央视）

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China-Africa trade sees multiple highlights in H1
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lin Jian chaired a regular press conference. A reporter noted that China-Africa trade achieved impressive results in the first half of this year, with significant effects from the full implementation of zero-tariff treatment for African countries that have diplomatic relations with China. Lin Jian said that in the first half of this year, China-Africa trade showed multiple highlights: first, a rapid increase in total volume, with bilateral trade reaching 1.41 trillion yuan, a record high for the period, and expected to reach new heights for the full year; second, continuous optimization of structure; third, the growing potential of African exports to China.

headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause

headlines.title_en: ChiNext Index surges over 3% on volume, Changxin Technology sees full-day turnover exceeding 140 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: 1. Overall trend: Markets strengthened throughout the day, with three major indices rising collectively. Stocks broadly advanced, with about 5,200 stocks in the Beijing-Shanghai-Shenzhen markets turning positive, and turnover reaching 2.09 trillion yuan. By close, Shanghai Composite rose 1.15%, Shenzhen Component rose 2.72%, and ChiNext Index rose 3.16%. 2. Sectors: Brain-computer interfaces, beauty care, batteries, and PCB led gains, while oil and insurance sectors fell against the trend. 3. Hot concepts and stocks: Changxin Technology debuted today with a surge of over 460%, turnover exceeding 140 billion yuan setting a record, surpassing ICBC to become the largest A-share market cap. Brain-computer interface concept exploded, with Aipeng Medical, Nanjing Panda, and InnoCare Pharma hitting limit up. Computing hardware stocks rallied, with International Composites, Honghe Technology, and Hongban Technology hitting limit up. Battery supply chain strengthened, with Shengyang Technology, Lopal Tech, and Wanli Shares hitting limit up.

headlines.title: 上半年中非贸易成绩亮眼 外交部：今年贸易总额有望再上新台阶
headlines.summary: 【上半年中非贸易成绩亮眼 外交部：今年贸易总额有望再上新台阶】林剑表示，今年上半年中非贸易亮点纷呈。一是总量加速跃升，中非的进出口商品总额达到1.41万亿元人民币，为历史同期最高，今年的贸易总额有望再上新台阶。二是结构持续优化。据统计，中国对非出口75%是资本品和中间品，主要是满足非方工业化和农业现代化需要的生产性资料，非消费资本。三是非洲对华出口的潜力不断释放，对非洲建交国全面实施零关税举措以后的五、六两个月，中国自非进口1938亿元人民币，同比增长了23.5%。

headlines.title_en: H1 China-Africa trade performance strong; Foreign Ministry expects total trade to reach new heights this year
headlines.summary_en: [China-Africa trade impressive in H1; Ministry: full-year trade expected to reach new highs] Lin Jian said that in H1, China-Africa trade highlights include: first, accelerated total volume growth, with trade reaching 1.41 trillion yuan, a historical high for the period, and full-year trade expected to surpass previous levels; second, optimized structure, with 75% of China's exports to Africa being capital and intermediate goods to meet production needs; third, growing African export potential, with China's imports from Africa in May and June after the zero-tariff policy hitting 193.8 billion yuan, up 23.5% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 光伏行业成本核算团体标准正式发布
headlines.summary: 日前，在国家市场监督管理总局、工业和信息化部指导下，由中国光伏行业协会牵头编制的团体标准《光伏行业成本核算模型通则》正式发布。本标准以企业会计准则为基础，通过统一“硅料—硅片—电池—组件”全产业链的成本计算范围、计算系数和计算模型，形成贯通产业链的成本核算框架，可破除行业内成本核算口径不一、各自表述的乱象。这是落实党中央、国务院关于规范市场竞争秩序、推动高质量发展部署的具体举措，也是光伏行业管理从自律倡议走向制度化、标准化的重要一步。

headlines.title_en: Group standard for photovoltaic industry cost accounting officially released
headlines.summary_en: Under the guidance of the State Administration for Market Regulation and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the group standard 'General Rules for Cost Accounting Models in the Photovoltaic Industry' compiled by the China Photovoltaic Industry Association was officially released. Based on accounting standards, it unifies cost calculation scope, coefficients, and models across the 'polysilicon-wafer-cell-module' chain, forming a cost accounting framework to eliminate inconsistent practices in the industry. This is a concrete step to implement central government directives on regulating market competition and promoting high-quality development, marking a shift from self-discipline initiatives to institutionalized and standardized industry management.

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stock movers | Sihuan Pharmaceutical surges over 18% intraday, expects H1 net profit growth of no less than 217%
headlines.summary_en: Sihuan Pharmaceutical (0460.HK) surged over 18% in the afternoon to HKD 1.04, with turnover expanding to HKD 145 million. The company released a profit forecast at midday, expecting H1 revenue of no less than 11.4 billion yuan, roughly flat year-on-year, and net profit of no less than 210 million yuan, up over 217% year-on-year.

headlines.summary: 外交部发言人林剑主持例行记者会。有记者问，今年上半年中非贸易取得亮眼成绩，对非洲建交国全面实施零关税举措成效显著。请问发言人对此有何评论？ 林剑表示，今年上半年，中非贸易亮点纷呈。 一是总量加速跃升。中非的进出口商品总额达到1.41万亿元人民币，为历史同期最高，今年的贸易总额有望再上新台阶。二是结构持续优化。三是非洲对华出口潜力不断释放。（央视）
